I’ll verify this against the English Wikipedia discography, restricting the count to studio albums dated 2000–2009 inclusive.
First I’m checking the available knowledge sources for a cached Wikipedia/discography entry; if it isn’t present, I’ll use Wikipedia search directly.
```python
knowledge_check = await knowledge_search_knowledge("Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009 English Wikipedia", scope="session")
print(knowledge_check)
```
```python
knowledge_check = await knowledge_search_knowledge("Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009 English Wikipedia", scope="session")
print(knowledge_check)
```
Need a source lookup now; I’m searching Wikipedia for the discography page and its album table.
```python
wiki_search = await wikipedia_search("Mercedes Sosa discography", max_results=5)
print(wiki_search)
``` 

```python
wiki_page = await web_search("site:en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes_Sosa_discography studio albums 2000 2009", max_results=5)
print(wiki_page)
``` 

```python
discography_page = await web_fetch("https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes_Sosa_discography", max_chars=30000)
print(discography_page)
``` 

```python
calc_check = await calculator("1+1")
print(calc_check)
``` 

```python
source_lookup = await knowledge_search_knowledge("English Wikipedia Mercedes Sosa discography studio albums 2000 2009", scope="all")
print(source_lookup)
``` 

4
